Class LessonsLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned
public class LessonsLearned extends Object

Title: LessonsLearned Class

Description: This entity class represents one lesson learned in the system. It holds the "core information" a contributor enters (title, description, category) and the values the system generates (id, author, created and updated timestamps). It follows the same pattern as the User entity class: private attributes, a constructor, getters, and a few setters.

Design note: the text setters remove leading and trailing spaces. Doing it here, in one place, means the validator and the database always see the same cleaned value, so a title of only spaces is treated as empty everywhere.

    • validate

      public String validate()

      Method: String validate()

      Description: Checks the lesson against the limits of the lessonLearnedDB table before it is stored. This covers the merged epic attributes, which LessonValidator does not check. Note that LessonValidator.DESCRIPTION_MAX is 1000 for the lessonDB path, while the lessonLearnedDB column allows 2000.

      Returns:
      an empty string when the lesson is valid, else the first problem found
